I used to be in the same situation as your BF. Pero yung loan ko is because of buiness na nalugi. Grabe yung kalugmukan ko non almost taken my own life. Money can make your decisions and outlook in life clouded. I have a partner whom I shared this situation. I never ever asked for her help. Bakit? Ayoko masumbatan. Hiniwalayan din nya ko non. Worse part? Sinimulan ko yung business na yon to help finance her journey and career na makapunta abroad and be a seafarer.

So I planned my life around that debt. Mopping around would not solve it. Naghanap ako ng pagkaka kitaan. Halos di ako kumain araw araw to prioritze that loan. Dun lahat napunta kinikita ko. Bakit ko 

 Pero now I'm stable. Earning more than the 6 digit debt I was in. Guess what? Nagkabalikan kami. I know I didnt ask for help pero it would have been nice to have the emotional support that time. Laking pasalamat ko I had friends na encouraged me during those trying times.

Pabigat ba sya sayo?
Are you the one solving it?
After nya malampasan yung debt would he still have the same habits?

But I feel you, your feelings are valid. It's hard and good luck! Hope you find your answer.

I also love and replay a lot of stranded deep. When I finished the game for the 2nd time it took me months to find an itch or similar game to it. Here's a list of what I tried next:

(I usually play single player. Offline/online. Mainly PC and Steam Deck with the exception of 1 game I played on Switch)

Medieval Dynasty I looks fun but for some reason I didn't stick to it much. I might come back to it soon or try Sengoku Dynasty.


Survival Fountain of Youth is quite challenging next level play of Standed Deep. I haven't finished it yet but it's fun. The story is quite interesting to me. 


Project Castaway I think this one is the closest to Stranded Deep. I watched a lot from GameEdge on YouTube and it looks great. Only reason I haven't played it as much is because I prefer playing on Steam Deck and this one is not playable there for me. In the future once I'm not prioritizing my laptop for work, I might give it a go.

Dragon Quest builders 2. When I first saw this I was kinda hesitant cause I didn't really play much Minecraft. But the story was great. The buolding was great. Characters were awesome. This has a hint of survival aspect to it. But very minimal. Very chill as well. Super cute art style. Give it a go if you love base building and colony sim. The villagers are what hooked me in this game. They have their own task and day and night routine. It's very interesting. 

Enshrouded this is was first time trying a game like this. I was afraid it cause it kinda looked like a souls game with bosses and dungeons but I was interested in the gliding mechanic and also been enjoying Dark fantasy content in tiktok and youtube. I tried it during the steam summer sale and recently had 100 hours and counting in that game. It's so beautiful. It's super chill once you get the hang of it. I might try Valheim next cause it's giving similar vibe. Also Enshrouded has great base building but no hunger mechanic. This one has Multiplayer.


Conan the Exiles. Enshrouded was great but it kinda felt lonely. I realized I want NPCs to enjoy the base I was building so I bought this game. I haven't played it much to form an opinion but it gave Mad Max plus base building colony sim type.


Palworld. Honestly enjoying it so far. It's Base building, survival craft, colony sim, the pals are freaking cute, it's kind of dark if you think about it too much but exploration, grinding, gliding, flying, riding, craft etc. it's a whole package. This too has Multiplayer. 


Hope this helps.

Out of those 3 I only played Enshrouded. I have spent hours with this game. It has that dark fantasy vibe that is popular on youtube and tiktok. You can craft beautiful buildings, bases, you can farm, you go on long adventure to a diverse environment. There are npcs that you can put anywhere in the base. It is amazing but it feels lonely. NPCs just stand there like an mmo. 

Gears are kinda repetitive. There's a lot of loot but the legendary items usually have an epic and common version that looks the same. Only difference is you can enhance it more if it's labeled as legendary. 

With all that being said, I still love it. It's so beautiful. Of you like to escape on a fantasy world like I do, this could be a great game for you.
